title: Compliance Personnel Verification (SFI & RST) — UDM Output
description: JSON contract for verifying SFI disclosure status and Research Security Training (RST) completion across every person named on a federal research proposal. The workflow joins three inputs (VERAS proposal package, institutional SFI disclosure records, daily RST completion spreadsheet) and produces a per-person compliance matrix with non-compliance flags and remediation priorities. Mirrors the source ui-insight/ProcessMapping compliance-personnel-verification workflow.

proposal_type.description: Whether the proposal is a research proposal. Required by source workflow.

sponsor_type.description: Whether the sponsor is federal, state, or non-federal. Required by source workflow.

sfi_rst_required.description: Whether SFI and RST checks are required for this proposal. Required by source workflow. True when proposal_type == 'Research' AND sponsor_type == 'Federal'; false otherwise.

section_66_personnel.description: Names listed in VERAS Section 6.6 requiring SFI disclosures. Required by source workflow (may be empty when the section is not present).

section_2_personnel.description: PIs and Senior/Key Personnel from VERAS Section 2. Required by source workflow. Must contain at least one entry (every proposal has a PI). Resolves to UDM Personnel.First_Name / Personnel.Last_Name.

consolidated_personnel.description: Deduplicated union of Section 6.6 and Section 2 personnel that require SFI and / or RST verification. Required by source workflow.

source_sections.description: Which VERAS source section(s) listed this person.

personnel_discrepancies.description: Differences between the Section 6.6 and Section 2 personnel lists (e.g., person in Section 2 but missing from Section 6.6). Empty array when the lists match.

sfi_verification.description: Per-person SFI disclosure verification records, one entry per person in consolidated_personnel.

disclosure_date.description: ISO YYYY-MM-DD when found; null otherwise.

days_since_disclosure.description: Days between disclosure_date and the proposal submission date. JSON integer. Null when disclosure_found is false.

valid_within_365_days.description: True when days_since_disclosure <= 365. Null when disclosure_found is false.

status.description: Valid = within 365 days; Expiring Soon = valid but within 30 days of expiration; Expired = > 365 days; Not Found = no disclosure on file; Review Required = ambiguous match.

spreadsheet_date.description: ISO YYYY-MM-DD date of the RST completion spreadsheet used for verification. Required by source workflow.

spreadsheet_source.description: Source label for the spreadsheet (e.g., 'UI Bridge daily export'). Required by source workflow.

records.description: Per-person RST completion records, one entry per person in consolidated_personnel.

completion_date.description: ISO YYYY-MM-DD when found; null otherwise.

non_compliant_personnel.description: Per-person compliance issue records (one person may have multiple entries when both SFI and RST fail). Empty array when every person is compliant.

priority.description: Critical = blocks submission (no SFI on file or RST not completed); High = SFI expired needs immediate renewal; Medium = SFI expires within 30 days.

overall_status.description: All Compliant = every person passed; Non-Compliance Found = at least one non-compliant entry; Not Applicable = sfi_rst_required is false.

notes.description: Source-document warnings (e.g., SFI records not provided, ambiguous name matches). Null when no notes apply.
